meta.title: Galereya Best — premium finishing materials in Tashkent
meta.desc: Galereya Best — IDEAL skirting and mouldings, ART FLOOR laminate, NMC decor, wall panels, sanitary ware. Over 4,500 items in stock in Tashkent.
meta.og_desc: Skirting, mouldings, laminate, decor and panels from leading international brands. Tashkent.
hero.lead: Skirting and mouldings, laminate, decorative elements and wall panels from leading European and international manufacturers. Over 4,500 items in stock — from a single order to fitting out an entire project.
cat.sub: Everything for the finishing stage: from the base profile to the final decorative detail.
cat.c1_d: Floor and ceiling skirting, cornices, corner and end pieces. The company's core category.
cat.c2_d: Laminate floors in a range of wear classes — for homes, offices and commercial spaces.
cat.c3_d: Decorative wall panels, including bamboo and slatted designs — for feature walls and ceilings.
cat.c5_d: Bathroom fixtures and components for plumbing and building services.
cat.c6_d: Interior doors, hardware and aluminium profiles for finishing solutions.
brands.sub: Direct supply and a stocked programme across key lines.
srv.h2: More than a sale — help at every step
srv.f1_d: We help you choose the right material for the job and calculate the quantity from your drawings or measurements — without costly leftovers.
srv.f3_d: We keep key lines in stock — no waiting months for delivery. Inventory records are updated daily.
srv.f4_d: Samples, catalogues and technical specifications. Dedicated terms for industry professionals.
srv.f5_d: Delivery across Tashkent and to the regions. Careful packing for long and fragile items.
srv.f6_d: We serve private customers and wholesale buyers alike. Flexible terms for regular volumes.
about.big: We supply finishing materials in Tashkent: from skirting and mouldings to laminate and wall panels.
about.p2: Over the years we have built a range that covers the whole finishing stage — so a customer does not need a dozen suppliers for one project. We keep a stocked programme of fast-moving lines and track inventory precisely, so the dates we promise are dates we can meet.
about.p3: Our customers include private clients, designers and contractors — from a single room to a complete project fit-out.
